title: Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #9

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   C. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

5. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   D. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   C. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim scholars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Types of verses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. A — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. D — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim scholars; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Types of verses; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
